hueLabsInformation.type.functional.descr: Hue labs is not accessible anymore. The saved formulas on your bridge will continue running. If you have any trouble with unexpected behavior or you just want to delete your formulas you can press the "Delete all formulas" button below.
hueLabsInformation.type.functional.faq.s: Which alternatives are there for you?
hueLabsInformation.type.informative.dele: Are you sure? This can't be undone.
hueLabsInformation.type.informative.desc:
After 7 years of testing new features, the Hue Labs experiment has come to an end! 

Many formulas have been promoted to built-in app features (with even more functionality!), so you can use those instead.

Because of its success, we've moved much of our beta testing to the app. You'll see "Beta" on features you can try out in the app.

Any automated formulas you still had installed will continue to run as is, but you won't able to edit them. To remove them, go to Settings > Bridge settings > Hue Labs.
How do I replace my formulas?

uc.deviceCommissioning.qrCodeScanning.ca: <olist><litem>On a <emph>camera</emph>: The QR code is on the Ownership card in the box.</litem><litem>On a <emph>contact sensor</emph>: Open the back plate of the sensor.</litem><litem>On a <emph>wall switch module</emph>: If the QR code is not on the back of this device, unscrew the bottom black screw and slide the device open.</litem><litem>In the device's manual: The QR code may be inside.</litem><litem>Some products might not have a QR code. Try to add the device by tapping the <emph>No QR code</emph> at the beginning of setup, which you can access by going back. You can also add it later.</litem></olist>
uc.deviceCommissioning.qrCodeScanning.iN: <olist><litem>Scanning the QR code is a fast and safe way to add a device to your system.</litem><litem>Indoor or outdoor motion sensor: These devices might not have scannable QR codes. Add these devices by tapping the <emph>No QR code</emph> button at the beginning of setup. Tap the arrow in the upper left of the screen to go back to this screen.</litem><litem>Can't find the QR code? Tap <emph>Find QR</emph> code below.</litem><litem>Is the QR code you try to scan quite small? Zoom in on the camera view using the pinch zoom gesture.</litem></olist>
